custody.retention: preserved terminal primary and replica roots plus separate qualification/closeout receipts
custody.repository_contents: code, tests, protocol, digest freezes/manifests, scalar aggregate reports

known_limitations: Small synthetic feedforward models; three guide seeds per family; finite frozen challenges, shared across paired arms/cases; no powered population or superiority inference.
All 9 selected-method cases pass native gates; only 9 of 27 selected-method aligned snapshots are available. No case has complete all-stage mapping availability.

Stem and head are initially retained from the guide; both nonlinear blocks are independently initialized and progressively learned. Replaced prefixes remain trainable at later stages; final task tuning updates all candidate parameters.
Derivative arms have additional arithmetic and are not FLOP matched; Jacobian matching and causal distillation have prior art. Procedural CKA comparator is not a full Network of Theseus reproduction.

Baseline training checks RSS periodically and phase wall budget between arms; its delegated inner loop does not have a separate wall deadline. Actual phases were within budget; no hard timeout guarantee is claimed.
Same owner and host with distinct runtime prefixes and site packages; no independent authority or external blind replication.
next_scientific_obligation: Freeze a separate corpus/intervention/adapter protocol for transferring the qualifying two-block derivative-supervised method to task-critical pretrained Transformer blocks, preserving fresh data and all-stage causal/rescue gates.
next_blocked_authority_gate: Blind external replication and an authorized independent review for stronger scientific claims; human-calibrated alignment and production operations remain separate.

engineering.prefreeze_failures: Two test-contract/lock-byte errors fixed and recorded before scientific data; frozen scientific identity not repaired or retried.
